title: Arquiteto De Soluções Oss
description:
Arquiteto de Soluções OSS – Grão Inteligência

Grão Inteligência é uma empresa de consultoria e tecnologia com sede no Brasil. Oferecemos soluções e serviços para otimizar a eficiência e a eficácia dos processos de negócios, abrangendo diversas áreas corporativas. Além disso, temos foco estratégico em soluções tecnológicas personalizadas, incluindo desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções de analytics. Somos reconhecidos pela nossa experiência em fornecer insights e soluções que ajudam nossos clientes a enfrentar desafios complexos, melhorar o desempenho operacional, gerenciar riscos e aproveitar oportunidades de crescimento.

Com mais de 10 anos de experiência, já trabalhamos com os mais diversos setores, incluindo varejo, bens de consumo, manufatura e serviços financeiros. Se você acredita que tem o potencial de exercer alguma função na Grão Inteligência, seja você um jovem talento ou alguém mais experiente, registre-se e deixe seu currículo na nossa base.

Estruturamos as equipes dos nossos projetos de acordo com cada demanda individual e você pode ser exatamente o que precisamos!

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em soluções de Telecomunicações conhecidas como OSS: Operations Support Systems;
  • Conhecimentos em aprovisionamento, viabilidade, inventário de planta externa e de serviço, gestão de ordens e soluções de força de campo (WFM);
  • Definir e implantar roadmap de integração;
  • Otimizar uso dos serviços e recursos tecnológicos existentes, assim como o desenvolvimento/esustentação de serviços de alta performance;
  • Atuar na avaliação de soluções, identificando débitos técnicos, obsolescências, oportunidades de adoção de novas soluções e manutenção das soluções disponíveis;
  • Auxiliar / orientar os desenvolvedores visando entregas ágeis e incrementais de soluções escaláveis e tolerantes a falhas em conjunto com especialistas;
  • Definir arquitetura escalável, flexível e resiliente;
  • Auxiliar especialistas na verificação da viabilidade e necessidade de utilização de novas tecnologias para desenvolvimento (front e back);
  • Monitorar o mercado para identificar tecnologias, startups e parceiros;
  • Manter e reportar o mapa / roadmap de arquitetura, apresentando as evoluções, riscos, débitos técnicos da matriz;
  • Orientar e acompanhar projetos, a fim de garantir a aplicação das diretrizes de Arquitetura de Soluções (visão integrada, negócio, aplicações, infraestrutura, segurança, integração);
  • Auxiliar na análise técnica de requisitos do projeto, mapeando os sistemas impactados e utilizando na definição da solução mais adequada de integração;
  • Apresentar tecnologias disponíveis e propor soluções para as demandas solicitadas, acompanhando os projetos em desenvolvimento, para garantir a utilização da tecnologia mais adequada;
  • Propor e avaliar ferramentas inovadoras para entregar a melhor experiência para os usuários;
  • Responsável pela análise, design e manutenção de desenhos de solução e de integração para projetos;
  • Efetuar o acompanhamento das entregas durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento, testes e garantir a entrega em produção;
  • Avaliar a solução AS‑IS e desenhar a solução ToBe, elaborando documentos de arquitetura técnica de Integração com a solução end‑to‑end das funcionalidades;
  • Validar e confirmar a viabilidade de implementação dos requisitos de negócio;
  • Garantir performance e segurança das soluções e serviços implementados nos projetos;
  • Colaborar com parceiros e usuários‑chave na definição de soluções, buscando a melhor solução que traga o menor impacto para o negócio.

Requisitos

  • Ciências da Computação; Engenharia da Computação; Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Hard Skills

  • CI/CD (DEV/SEC/OPS); Cloud Computing (AWS, OpenStack, Azure, Digital Ocean etc); Weblogic; Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Padrões de Projeto em JAVA; repositórios SVN/GIT e Nexus;
  • OSS Padrões estabelecidos pelo TMForum – Framework (TAM, TOM e Open APIs);
  • Arquiteturas de Integração de média e alta complexidade (REST, SOA, API Gateway, Microservices);
  • Conhecimento em Open API, Swagger, Developer Portal;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços e tecnologias correlatas (OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, Grafana, Jaeger, etc.);
  • Arquitetura Java EE; Conhecimentos em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais (DDL, DML, transações, restrições de integridade, índices, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Arquiteturas Web, Portais, Middleware e Infraestrutura;
  • Conhecimento de Camadas arquiteturais (front‑end, integração, back‑end);
  • Conhecimento em DevOps, Jenkins e Nexus;
  • Conhecimento em repositórios SVN/GIT;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de inventário OpenLabs – Netwin;
  • Conhecimentos em soluções OSS de inventário de Planta Interna e Externa, como Granite, Netwin, Ativação, WFM‑Força de Campo;
  • Conhecimentos em soluções OSM/Ordering (Oracle SOM);
  • Vivência com metodologia ágil.

Specific Tech

  • Conhecimento da plataforma Layer 7 API Gateway e Developer Portal da Broadcom;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de WFM Field Service (Oracle Field Service / Salesforce FieldService / Mulesoft; Netwin/NETQ);
  • Conhecimentos em soluções de georreferenciamento – Digicade GEOSITE.

Soft Skills

  • Analítico; Autodidata; Autogestão; Boa comunicação; Dinâmico.

Desejável

  • Inglês;
  • Certificado Cloud.

title: CRO Expert
description:
Company Introduction

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth. With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods. If you're looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About The Role

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients' websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates. This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members. Your responsibilities will include developing CRO strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented.

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients' e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General Responsibilities

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency's clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients' websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands' landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position Specifications

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month

Requirements

About You

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients' CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment. Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.

Key Traits

You should demonstrate great attention to detail, strong communication skills, as well as excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities. A sense of proactivity, hunger for growth, and a consistent, highly communicative work ethic will work in your favor. You will also need a forward-thinking approach to anticipate shifts in user feedback and industry trends, and you should be highly adaptable and open to continuous learning to help you stay ahead in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape. Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Key Requirements

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the CRO field
  • Proven experience in a similar CRO role, specifically within the e-commerce industry
  • A proven track record of improving conversion rates for e-commerce clients
  • Proficiency in analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Clarity, and Convert.com as well as excellent data analysis skills to provide actionable insights to our clients
  • A strong understanding of UX/UI principles and how they affect conversion rates
  • A demonstrated ability to run A/B and multivariate tests from start to finish
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms (such as Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) and the specific challenges involved in optimizing the user's experience
  • Being familiar with heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
  • skills for effectively presenting test results and recommendations to the team and the clients (direct client communication will not be a requirement of the role, at least not as originally intended)
  • A proactive attitude with a strong focus on delivering high-quality results
  • Being able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Being able to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • An excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding solutions
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your own time independently and effectively
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it
  • Must be available and responsive during our office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Must be able to consistently work full-time

Finanças Sustentáveis

  • avaliação do desempenho em sustentabilidade de empresas, ativos e instrumentos financeiros;

Quem vier estagiar aqui será alocado em uma equipe atuante em uma dessas frentes, com possibilidade de troca a cada ano de estágio. Vai interagir com outras pessoas estagiárias, analistas, consultores e especialistas para a realização dos projetos junto aos clientes.

  • Habilidade para expressar ideias, tanto por escrito quanto verbalmente;

  • Comprometimento e responsabilidade.

  • Formações preferenciais: Administração; Economia; Engenharia de Produção; Relações Internacionais, Gestão Ambiental ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para 30h semanais em regime híbrido.

Atividades em Estágio em Finanças Sustentáveis

  • Pesquisar e analisar indicadores de desempenho ambiental, social e de governança corporativa de empresas de capital aberto ou emissoras de dívida;
  • Dar suporte em avaliação de produtos financeiros sustentáveis (títulos verdes, fundos de investimento verdes etc.);

DEIB

Na ERM, sabemos que criar um ambiente de trabalho diverso, equitativo e inclusivo é parte essencial para tornar nossa empresa um ótimo lugar para construir uma carreira.

title: Lead Engineer / Tech Lead, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack:

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (required)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What we are looking for (Qualifications):

  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process

Nice to have (strongly preferred):

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How we work:

  • Remote, Americas-based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two-week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

Why this role and join us?

Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

Key responsibilities

  • Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
  • Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
  • Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
  • Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
  • Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
  • Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
  • Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
  • Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
  • Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
  • Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

description:
Somos mais de 40 mil pessoas que atuam com foco em segurança, integridade, colaboração e simplificação, os pilares que sustentam nossa cultura.

Geramos valor para nossos acionistas, clientes e parceiros e colaboradores a partir de um ecossistema integrado de negócios que começa com o cultivo da cana-de-açúcar até chegar na produção e comercialização de etanol, açúcar e bioenergia.

Atuamos ainda – sob licença da marca Shell – na distribuição de combustíveis, lubrificantes e outras especialidades no Brasil, além de operações de refino na Argentina e distribuição de derivados de combustíveis e lubrificantes na Argentina e no Paraguai.

Se identificou?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor de Manutenção II para atuar no time de Lubrificantes na Ilha do Governador/RJ .

Responsabilidades e atribuições

COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Supervisionar a operação e manutenção dos sistemas de utilidades: compressores de ar e secadores; caldeiras; sistemas de água (captação/abastecimento, tratamento e distribuição); rede de gás natural; aquecedor e circuito de óleo térmico; sistemas de vapor nas dependências fabris;
  • Planejar e aprovar PMOC/planos de manutenção, backlog e sobressalentes críticos; coordenar inspeções legais (NR-13/vasos de pressão/caldeiras), testes de segurança e calibrações de instrumentação;
  • Monitorar KPIs (disponibilidade, MTBF/MTTR, consumo específico, perdas, custo por m³/ton/kWh/Nm³) e liderar planos de ação para segurança, gente, melhoria continua, performance, confiabilidade e eficiência energética;
  • Gerir equipe (turnos/escala/treinamentos), contratos e orçamento (OPEX/CAPEX), assegurando compliance com SSMA, qualidade e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar, tratar e liderar análises de causas (RCA), processos para gestão de mudanças (GMUD) e planos de contingência para indisponibilidade de utilidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Formação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Química, Elétrica ou Automação) ou Tecnólogo com sólida experiência em utilidades industriais;
  • Experiência em operação/manutenção de sistemas de utilidades: compressores, secadores de ar, caldeiras, queimadores, redes de gás natural e sistemas de óleo térmico;
  • Conhecimento em NR-13, NR-10, NR-12, NR-20 e legislações ambientais (INEA/CONAMA);
  • Leitura de P&ID, instrumentação e noções de automação (CLP/SDCD, intertravamentos);
  • Vivência com gestão de contratos, CAPEX, KPIs de manutenção e eficiência energética.

Sua energia se destaca mais se você tiver estes itens:

  • Certificação NR-13 (responsável por vasos/caldeiras) e conhecimento em ISO 50001;
  • Experiência nos setores de óleo e gás, químico, alimentos/bebidas ou lubrificantes;
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão (ISO 14001/9001, SSMA) e metodologias Lean, TPM, RCA, RCM e técnicas preditivas (análise vibracional, termografia, ultrassom).

Informações adicionais

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO:

Nosso processo contempla 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

  • Inscrição - preenchimento deste formulário e de dados adicionais, caso necessário.
  • Entrevista com o RH - um bate-papo para nos conhecermos.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: bate-papo mais técnico para contar ainda mais sobre o dia a dia e os desafios.

Nossa comunicação será por e-mail e telefone - confira se seus dados estão atualizados.

Retail & Licensing Coordinator

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The main responsibilities and oversights of the Coordinator, Licensing & Retail – for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 27™ include:

  • Assist in coordinating and managing licensing agreements with partners, ensuring compliance with contractual terms and timelines.
  • Support the production and distribution of licensed merchandise, including coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners.
  • Analyse sales data and generate reports on merchandise performance, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to optimize sales strategies.
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to gather insights on consumer preferences, trends, and potential opportunities for licensing and retail activities.
  • Support the development and execution of marketing and promotional campaigns for licensed merchandise, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate inventory records, monitoring stock levels, and coordinating inventory replenishment as needed.
  • Provide operational support for retail partnerships, including coordinating product displays, ensuring brand compliance, and addressing partner inquiries.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective communication and alignment.
  • Manage the product approval of different Licensees across the three phases: graphic, pre-production and production
  • Support the maintenance of licensing and retail databases and systems, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information.
  • Assist in managing licensing and retail budgets, tracking expenses, and providing financial analysis and reporting.
  • Support the coordination of licensing and retail-related events, such as trade shows, product launches, and promotional activities.

YOUR PROFILE

Competencies and personality

  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Knowledge about Brazilian market trends
  • Good understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistent, eager and quick learner.

  • Order stocks to maintain minimum levels.

  • Issue stock / ensure that adequate levels are available for other users.
  • 5) Communicate Information (Written And Orally), Accurately, Concisely And Promptly
  • Process incoming and outgoing communications.

  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.

Infraestrutura e Administração Cloud

  • Provisionar, configurar e otimizar infraestrutura como código (IaC).

  • Gerenciar ambientes containerizados com Docker e Kubernetes, preferencialmente AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service).

  • Otimizar continuamente pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo automação, deploy seguro e rollback controlado.

Dados e Bancos de Dados

  • Administrar e otimizar soluções de dados no Azure, incluindo Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL e Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Implementar estratégias de backup, replicação e alta disponibilidade para bases de dados.

  • Colaborar com times de dados na otimização de pipelines e arquitetura.

Monitoramento e Observabilidade

  • Implementar e manter stack de monitoramento com Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor e Log Analytics.

  • Apoiar troubleshooting proativo e análises de performance de aplicações.

Segurança e Governança

  • Implementar e manter RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) e IAM (Identity and Access Management).
  • Garantir práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo firewalls, SSL/TLS e criptografia de dados.
  • Assegurar conformidade com políticas de segurança e padrões regulatórios.
  • Realizar auditorias de segurança e análises de vulnerabilidades.

Otimização de Custos (FinOps)

  • Monitorar e otimizar custos de nuvem, identificando desperdícios e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Implementar práticas de rightsizing, uso de instâncias reservadas e spot instances.
  • Aplicar governança e controle de custos.
  • Gerar relatórios de consumo e custos para diferentes stakeholders.

Gestão de Incidentes e Operações

  • Monitorar a saúde dos ambientes de produção e responder a incidentes críticos.
  • Atuar em troubleshooting avançado de infraestrutura, aplicações e bancos de dados.
  • Documentar runbooks e procedimentos de recuperação para cenários críticos.

Colaboração e Evolução Contínua

  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com times de desenvolvimento e operação.
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas junto a times de produto e tecnologia do setor público.

  • Contribuir para a modernização de aplicações e adoção de arquiteturas cloud-native.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior completa (tecnólogo, graduação e/ou pós-graduação lato sensu e/ou stricto sensu) na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência sólida como DevOps Engineer ou Infrastructure Engineer em ambientes Azure em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Histórico comprovado na criação, manutenção e evolução de pipelines CI/CD em ambientes de produção críticos.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting avançado de sistemas distribuídos e resolução de incidentes.

Conhecimentos Técnicos – Azure

  • Administração de máquinas virtuais, redes virtuais e load balancers.
  • Configuração e gerenciamento de armazenamento (Storage Accounts, Blob Storage, Data Lake).
  • Atuação com bancos de dados: Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL e Fabric.
  • Implementação de backup, disaster recovery e alta disponibilidade.

  • Práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo RBAC, firewalls e grupos de segurança.

Monitoramento e Observabilidade

  • Familiaridade com Azure Monitor, Log Analytics e Application Insights.
  • Criação de dashboards e alertas em ambientes produtivos.

Bancos de Dados

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

  • CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) ou certificações Kubernetes equivalentes

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model’s capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos autonomia e proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. A colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nosso objetivo é enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, melhorando sua vida através do que entregamos.

O time de Banking:

A estrutura de Product Platforms | Banking tem o propósito de prover serviços bancários para todos os segmentos da StoneCo, auxiliando no engajamento da base de clientes, no aumento do LTV e na redução de churn, tornando-se uma das principais fontes de receita da companhia através dos times de Core Transacional, Cartões, Baas, BPNA, Banking Processes e Open Finance.

Nosso objetivo é desenvolver soluções que garantam que, após a venda, o empreendedor possa receber e usar seu dinheiro, pagando seus funcionários, fornecedores e tributos, além de administrar seus recursos para prosperar.

Atuamos em todo o ciclo de vida do cliente, conectando suas vendas à gestão de sua empresa, apresentando e ampliando nossa gama de serviços, garantindo que sejamos seu provedor financeiro único.

title: Quantitative Project Manager (Remote)
description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems. Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements. Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide. M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end‑client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties include

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
  • Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, manage respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
  • Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
  • Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • At least 2‑3 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
  • Self‑motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Well‑developed analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present and proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • Basic math skills and ability to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
  • Very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on‑time in a fast‑paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

Additional Information

Personal Characteristics

  • Focus on data-driven decision making

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

description:
Técnico(a) de Enfermagem (Hemodinâmica) – Rede D’Or – Freguesia

Requisitos

  • Formação: Curso técnico em enfermagem completo.
  • Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.
  • Experiência nas rotinas do Centro Cirúrgico e Hemodinâmica.

Atividades

  • Através do pedido médico, checar previamente se todo o material necessário para início dos atos operatórios, inclusive materiais consignados, encontram‑se a disposição nas salas de cirurgias, priorizando os procedimentos de maior complexidade, a fim de comunicar as respectivas equipes médicas às disponibilidades dos mesmos;
  • Manter a sala cirúrgica de acordo com cada cirurgia e montar a mesa do procedimento utilizando técnica asséptica;
  • Fazer o check‑list dos pacientes na admissão e na saída do centro de intervenção cardiovascular, verificando os itens especificados em formulário próprio para cada situação, a fim de garantir a segurança do mesmo;
  • Providenciar a higienização dos equipamentos expostos, bem como os cabos e fios correspondentes, removendo sujidades dos mesmos e das superfícies, conforme definido nas normas e procedimentos da Unidade;
  • Verificar o funcionamento dos gases e equipamentos e iluminação da sala sob sua responsabilidade, tomando as providências necessárias para a manutenção da temperatura adequada do ambiente;
  • Auxiliar na transferência do paciente da maca para a mesa cirúrgica certificando‑se do correto posicionamento do paciente, da placa de bisturi para o ato cirúrgico, bem como dos cateteres, sondas e drenos;
  • Notificar possíveis intercorrências ao enfermeiro responsável, a fim de resolver a situação não planejada;
  • Preencher corretamente todos os impressos pertinentes ao prontuário do paciente e à instituição, registrando todos os procedimentos ocorridos no ato cirúrgico;
  • Controlar a quantidade de materiais, compressas e gazes e equipamentos utilizados pela equipe médica no início da cirurgia, como fator de segurança para o paciente e controle da Unidade;
  • Auxiliar na paramentação da equipe cirúrgica, bem como abrir os materiais estéreis utilizando técnicas assépticas, definida nas normas emitidas pela CCIH;
  • Encaminhar peças, exames, e outros pedidos devidamente protocolados no transcorrer da cirurgia;
  • Auxiliar o anestesiologista na indução / reversão do procedimento anestésico, caso o enfermeiro não tenha condições de estar presente;
  • Realizar a desmontagem da sala cirúrgica, encaminhando materiais à CME;
  • Checar validade de materiais armazenados no arsenal da hemodinamica;
  • Realizar rotina do setor as 07:00 com registro nos check‑list das salas cirúrgicas e Unidade Pós Angioplastia;

Outras informações

  • Local de trabalho: Freguesia , Jacarepaguá , Rio de Janeiro – RJ.
  • Escala de trabalho: à combinar.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento.

Missão do cargo

Responsável pela execução das estratégias (Fotografia de Sucesso) definidas para o canal e região nas suas lojas de atuação, garantindo a exposição e organização de nossos produtos nos clientes, assim como estabelecer um bom relacionamento, identificar novas oportunidades e atendimento com todos os stakeholders da loja, de modo a maximizar os negócios junto de seus clientes.

  • Controle do estoque virtual, acompanhando o estoque sistêmico e físico, e quando necessário fazer a sugestão de pedidos à loja
  • Realizar a rotação preventiva considerando o conceito “primeiro que vence e primeiro que sai” em todos os produtos do estoque, pontos extras e gôndolas
  • Garantir que todos os produtos expostos na loja estejam precificados de acordo com a política de preços definida pela HEINEKEN BRASIL, sendo eles nos pontos primários ou secundários de vendas
  • Realizar a ativação de todas as campanhas solicitadas com material de merchandising, racks, montagem de Materiais Permanentes etc.
  • Realizar pesquisas de avaliação na loja, a fim de promover melhorias ou reparar possíveis desacordos com a execução padrão da HEINEKEN BRASIL

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. Trabalhamos com marcas incríveis, que as pessoas amam, e com valores que direcionam um modelo de negócio vencedor. Acreditamos no nosso #timedeestrelas e oferecemos um ambiente leve, informal e respeitoso para que todas as nossas pessoas se sintam confortáveis para ser quem são e, dessa forma, sejam protagonistas de suas carreiras. É assim que caminhamos diariamente em busca da realização do nosso sonho no Brasil: levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro.

title: Cro & Shopify Developer

description: About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

    Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.
  • Intervenção
    Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.
  • Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento
    Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.

title: Head of Communications & Media Relations
description:
Head of Communications & Media Relations

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Communications & Media Relations will lead the strategic planning and delivery of communications, media relations and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible for the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, overseeing all activities in the lead‑up to and throughout the event, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in shaping the public narrative of the tournament, driving visibility, engagement and trust across key audiences.

Reporting jointly to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership team in Brazil and to FIFA’s Communications Division in Europe, the Head of Communications & Media Relations will lead a central Communications & Media team and work in close coordination with internal and external stakeholders across Brazil, South America and the global FIFA network. The role will ensure a consistent, high‑impact approach across corporate communications, content production, communications services, media relations and public relations.

The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker and hands‑on leader: a problem‑solver, integrator and collaborator with exceptional communication skills. They will be expected to contribute to—and where required, drive—key cross‑functional initiatives that support the tournament’s objectives and FIFA’s broader mission.

A core part of the role is to connect content, social media and video storytelling into a coherent, audience‑first communications approach that builds, maintains and grows fan engagement and public awareness of the tournament. The role will also leverage existing tools and propose innovative methods to measure, monitor and optimise communications impact throughout the tournament lifecycle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Head of Communications & Media Relations is responsible for safeguarding and enhancing the awareness, promotion and reputation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and FIFA across Brazil and South America. The role ensures that all communications activities are strategically aligned, audience‑focused and delivered consistently across disciplines, in line with FIFA and FIFA Women’s World Cup™ brand, values and principles, and with the tournament’s local and global objectives.

All activities are coordinated closely with FIFA Headquarters on a daily basis to ensure alignment, consistency and coherence across all markets.

Corporate communications
  • Lead a corporate communications‑first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Oversee messaging development for initiatives, campaigns, announcements and all FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications‑related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre‑emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Lead issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead‑up to and during the tournament.
Content production
  • Commission, develop and oversee the production and amplification of high‑quality corporate and tournament content across all formats (text, video, photography, graphics).
  • Ensure content is distributed effectively across owned and operated platforms (website, app, social media, FIFA Digital Hub, FIFA Media Hub, email) as well as through media partners and other relevant channels.
  • Define and manage integrated content plans that support fan engagement, strengthen the tournament narrative and reinforce the FIFA and FIFA Women’s World Cup™ reputation and image.
Digital products and innovation
  • Work with digital products teams to conceptualise, deliver and maintain premium, fan‑ and stakeholder‑focused digital experiences aligned with FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ objectives.
  • Ensure a stakeholder‑first, multi‑platform digital communications experience.
  • Advise senior leadership on digital and media strategy, including emerging trends, narratives, influencers and new engagement opportunities.
Media relations
  • Lead all media relations activities related to the tournament across Brazil and South America, positioning FIFA as a modern, dynamic and trusted sports organisation and highlighting the tournament’s sporting, cultural and social impact.
  • Oversee the delivery of high‑quality media services, content and briefings, ensuring fair, accurate and balanced coverage.
  • Provide strategic oversight of the FIFA Media Hub in relation to FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Take ownership of official media responses related to the tournament published on FIFA platforms and social media channels.
Public relations (PR)
  • Maximise awareness and understanding of the tournament through strategic PR initiatives, social impact campaigns, media partnerships, interviews and high‑profile events.
  • Manage agencies and external partners to ensure consistent, high‑impact PR delivery across Brazil and South America.
Additional responsibilities
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum 10 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football and a passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non‑traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem: • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

Descrição

Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos cujo objetivo é contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

  • Atualizar e disponibilizar o quadro de horários e reservas de salas conforme disciplina e/ou curso;

  • Conferir e atualizar dados cadastrais dos alunos da instituição;
  • Zelar pelo bom funcionamento da instituição, relatando qualquer desconformidade acadêmica, operacional e de infraestrutura.

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. description:
About The Job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) is seeking a smart, creative, and hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a squad dedicated to our high-stakes Enterprise and Corporate B2B partners. You will be at the heart of our mission to revolutionize travel technology for global giants. In this role, you aren't just a manager—you are a technical steward and a people multiplier . You will lead a high-performing team of talented engineers building complex, distributed systems that handle millions of transactions. You’ll navigate the intersection of technical excellence, enterprise-grade reliability, and the rapid "zero-to-one" pace that defines Hopper.

What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like
  • Hire, mentor, and coach a multidisciplinary squad. You’ll be responsible for building a high-trust culture where engineers are empowered to act like owners.
  • Partner closely with product teams to translate "big-picture" partner needs into executable technical roadmaps. You’ll ensure we ship high-quality features while managing the unique complexities of B2B integrations and public-facing APIs.
  • While you won't be coding 100% of the time, you will stay deeply technical. You’ll lead architectural reviews, help unblock complex debugging sessions, and ensure our stack remains scalable and resilient.
  • Own the "run" of your team’s services. This means establishing on-call rotations, driving down technical debt strategically, and ensuring our systems meet the strict SLAs required by our enterprise corporate partners.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for external partners. You must be able to explain complex system constraints to non-technical stakeholders and advocate for the best technical path forward. There may be some travel within North America for client meetings.
You Are a Perfect Fit If You
  • Have 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams and 7+ years in software development (ideally with JVM/Scala or React experience).
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can build the "MVP" without sacrificing the long-term integrity of the system.
  • You have experience with microservices, distributed systems, and designing APIs that are robust enough for global enterprise use.
  • You prefer a "ship and iterate" approach. You can distinguish between what needs to be perfect on Day 1 and what can be optimized on Day 30.
  • You find more satisfaction in your team’s success than your individual commits. You have a proven track record of growing junior engineers into seniors and seniors into leads/architects.
Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us
  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.
