title: Academic Dean, US Diploma Pathway
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives?

Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programs and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programs while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Program remains central as it continues to serve students globally. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance, and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services, and day-to-day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem-solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programs, student check-ins, faculty communication, and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward-thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments, and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities 1. Student Success & Community Building
  • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
  • Attend and support student processes and school-wide assemblies
  • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
  • Support and mentor student leaders in their roles and initiatives, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
  • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and student recognition programs
  • Support implementation of best practices in online high school community engagement
  • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
  • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
  • Lead student homeroom programs across all sections to ensure consistent quality
  • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with student wellbeing programs and family communications
2. Faculty Development & Curriculum Support
  • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans, and school leadership on policy development, implementation, and review
  • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting the Deputy Principal with teacher observations and feedback
  • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance, and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals, supporting the Deputy Principal's oversight of academic programs
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
  • Create curriculum mapping documentation to ensure vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects, supporting the Deputy Principal's curriculum oversight responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain curriculum standards that reflect both US diploma requirements and global best practices
  • Design and implement assessment strategies that align with curriculum objectives and measure student achievement effectively
  • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
  • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching, and maintain consistent staff communication
  • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes, supporting the Deputy Principal's staff development initiatives
  • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Provide day‑to‑day support for group class instructors, allowing the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic instructional leadership
3. Operational Excellence & Administrative Support
  • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation, and periodic review
  • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates to all stakeholders
  • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
  • Coordinate effectively across multiple time zones to support CGA's global student body
  • Support in maintaining organized student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
  • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, working collaboratively with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
  • Apply strong knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer credit policy to support student academic planning and course placement decisions
  • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
  • Assist with communications to students, parents, and staff regarding academic programs, policies, and diploma requirements
  • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
  • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
  • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
  • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses learning modes
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
  • Help manage day‑to‑day operational tasks, enabling the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic problem‑solving and complex challenges
Qualifications
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements, and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in education program development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counseling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritization abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels, particularly in supporting the Deputy Principal's strategic initiatives
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school's mission
About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Program provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses.

description:
A NEORIS, agora parte da EPAM, é uma Aceleradora Digital que ajuda empresas a darem o próximo passo em direção ao futuro. Localidade: Rio de Janeiro

Descrição do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um Líder de Migração de Dados para atuar em um programa SAP S/4HANA + IS-U de alta complexidade, envolvendo grande volumetria de dados, regras regulatórias e dependências críticas entre sistemas. Este profissional será responsável por definir a estratégia, governança, arquitetura e execução ponta-a-ponta da migração, garantindo precisão, integridade, rastreabilidade e estabilidade operacional do Go-Live.

Responsabilidades
  • Definir a arquitetura e estratégia de migração de dados para S/4HANA + IS-U, integrando informações do CCS e sistemas legados comerciais, técnicos e operacionais.
  • Estruturar o Migration Roadmap, incluindo escopo, objetos, volumetria, ondas de carga, dry runs e readiness.
  • Orquestrar a migração de dados mestres, transacionais, regulatórios e históricos, alinhando critérios ANEEL/Utilities.

  • Implementar controle rigoroso de versionamento, rastreabilidade e reconciliação.
  • Conduzir a migração utilizando ferramentas SAP (Migration Cockpit, LTMOM, Data Services, BTP, ABAP Cloud), liderando execuções de mock loads, carga final e cutover.
  • Liderar fóruns de governança de dados, interagir com áreas de Arquitetura, IS-U, Backoffice, Integrações e Cutover, garantindo alinhamento metodológico com SAP Activate.
  • Garantir estabilidade dos dados no Go-Live, liderando reconciliações, correções e governança pós-carga.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada como Líder de Migração de Dados em programas SAP S/4HANA ou IS-U.
  • Vivência real com migração de CCS para SAP Utilities (ou CIS equivalentes).
  • Domínio dos modelos de dados IS-U (BP, Contratos, Instalações, Equipamentos, Medição, Débitos, Faturamento, Ordens).
  • Experiência com alto volume de dados e ambientes regulados por ANEEL.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de migração SAP (Migration Cockpit, LTMOM, Data Services).
  • Experiência com governança de dados, reconciliação, cleansing e controle de qualidade.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro.
  • Inglês intermediário.
Diferenciais
  • Certificações SAP (IS-U, S/4HANA, Data Migration).
  • Vivência com SAP BTP para pipelines, APIs e cargas automatizadas.
  • Experiência com SAP MDG para governança de dados mestres.
  • Familiaridade com integrações de medição e redes técnicas.
  • Experiência com cargas paralelas de alta volumetria.

Descrição da vaga

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

title: Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica
description:
Join to apply for the Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica role at e.Quality Soluções e Engenharia LTDA

O Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica é o líder técnico e gestor das operações de engenharia clínica em sua unidade de atuação, assegurando a gestão segura, eficaz e economicamente responsável do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele garante a excelência na execução dos serviços, a conformidade com as regulamentações, a otimização dos recursos e o desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, atuando como um pilar fundamental para a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade do serviço.

  • Gestão Operacional e Conformidade: Assegurar a implementação e a manutenção contínua dos processos definidos no Plano de Gerenciamento de Tecnologias em Saúde (PGTS) da unidade, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas designados. Garantir a total conformidade das operações e documentações com a legislação vigente, normas técnicas (ex: NBR IEC 60601, ISO/IEC 17025 quando aplicável) e regulamentações (ANVISA, INMETRO). Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso. Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios. Acompanhar a performance individual e da equipe, provendo feedback construtivo e participando ativamente do desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores. Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
  • Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico: Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes. Supervisionar e acompanhar a execução da manutenção planejada (preventiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e a emissão dos laudos e certificados. Assegurar o correto preenchimento e registro de todas as atividades no sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), desde a abertura da solicitação até a avaliação do serviço prestado. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratos: Supervisionar os serviços realizados por terceiros e a execução de contratos dentro da unidade, por meio da análise das ordens de serviço externas. Avaliar o custo-benefício de contratos e serviços avulsos de terceiros, propondo otimizações ou alternativas. Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Confeccionar relatórios técnicos detalhados de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica. Realizar análises críticas para apresentar ao cliente o status dos equipamentos, sugerindo soluções técnicas e economicamente viáveis para otimizar a gestão do parque tecnológico. Manter o coordenador imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e desafios, buscando soluções e alinhando estratégias em reuniões e contatos diários.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente e Expansão de Serviço: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico principal com a equipe e gestão do hospital cliente para assuntos relacionados à engenharia clínica. Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.
  • Gestão de Ativos e Recursos: Zelar pela conservação e organização de todos os equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, solicitando reposição quando necessário. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

#VemSerMAG

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

  • Monitorar a efetividade das trilhas e programas sob a ótica do negócio, utilizando indicadores, dados e feedbacks para ajustes contínuos e tomada de decisão.
Requisitos e qualificações

  • Acompanhar e orientar a manutenção de registros, sua organização e arquivamento dos documentos relacionados ao faturamento de acordo com as políticas da empresa;
  • Contribuir na preparação dos relatórios gerenciais, visando assegurar a disponibilidade de informações financeiras e sobre andamento dos trabalhos e resultados alcançados, objetivando o suporte adequado ao processo decisório para análise e tomada de decisão;

  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência.
Requisitos e qualificações

description:
Job Description

Founded in 2014, EP2C ENERGY is a fast‑growing technical assistance and engineering consulting company operating in the fields of Energy (Renewable Energies, Oil & Gas, Nuclear), Life Sciences (Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics and Agri‑food industries), and Large Industrial Construction Projects (Mining, Construction, Water Treatment, Petrochemicals and Chemicals).

Our international footprint, with subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa and Asia, enables us to work alongside major players in our sectors while offering real career development opportunities to our employees, both in France and worldwide.

As a human‑sized company, we are committed to supporting and developing our employees, who are recognized and valued for their expertise and know‑how.

Joining EP2C Energy means taking part in an ambitious and rewarding journey.

To strengthen our teams and support our continued growth, we are currently looking for a Reservoir Engineer (M/F) in Rio de Janeiro.

Key Responsibilities
  • Validate collected reservoir data (mainly dynamic data), and integration into reservoir databases.
  • Perform dynamic data interpretation and synthesis to update field’s subsurface understanding.
  • Evaluate the main subsurface uncertainties, and account for their impact in reserves and production profiles evaluations.
  • Identify required model revisions and updates. Contribute to reservoir model new‑built and modifications (dynamic part). Ensure adequacy of reservoir models and other evaluation tools for production forecasting, reserves evaluations and uncertainties analysis.
  • Follow‑up geosciences and reservoir studies and projects carried out at head‑quarter. Contribute necessary data exchanges with HQ.
  • Develop own skills in Reservoir Engineering and Simulation by keeping close contact with specialist staff in the affiliate and HQ entities.
  • Ensure integration with other geosciences disciplines and senior geosciences integrators.
  • Apply Company dedicated rules for ensuring geosciences patrimonial data protection.
  • Provide adequate tools and methodology to the Assets for influencing the operator on field management and development.
  • Perform the necessary reservoir engineering interpretation and synthesis studies to improve subsurface understanding and model predictability.
  • Participate in building and updating the affiliate’s subsurface databases.
Profile Required
  • Background: Master in Reservoir/Petroleum Engineering
  • Knowledge in pre‑salt reservoirs and context
  • Professional exposure: 3‑8 years of experience (preferably with an operator)
  • Technical skills: Reservoir simulation software (Eclipse/IX); Reservoir interpretation software (PETEX suite, Kappa Saphir, OFM…); and subsurface databases.
Commitments

EP2C Energy is committed to diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities.

As part of our Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE) policy, strict compliance with QHSE rules is essential to ensure a safe working environment and to contribute positively to environmental protection. By joining our teams, you will be required to follow HSE procedures and best practices, while actively contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

Don’t wait any longer—apply now!

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

title: Venue Technology Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.
YOUR PROFILE Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
Experience
  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects
Skills & Competencies
  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.

Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.

As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.

The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

O que você fará:

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;
  • Se comunicar, sempre que necessário, com a família e com outros profissionais que trabalham com os alunos sob sua responsabilidade fora da escola, compartilhando informações necessárias para o bom atendimento dos alunos;
  • Demonstrar profissionalismo através de manutenção de confidencialidade de informações, compromisso com o crescimento dos mediadores, compromisso com horários e manutenção de ambiente justo e ético.

Procuramos manter a transparência: nenhuma atividade é restritiva; a lista pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se apliquem ao cargo.

O que você precisar ter:

  • Pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia;
  • Experiência com mediação e inclusão de alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Experiência com alunos do segmento da vaga;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais.
DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

OInspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Senior/Staff/Principal Engineer
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior/Staff/Principal Engineer role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior/Staff/Principal Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general track for Senior+ (Senior/Staff/Principal) Engineers in any team at Canonical. After the first round of interviews we will establish which teams might be an excellent fit, and progress your application with them.

At Canonical a Senior+ Engineer is not only an outstanding software architect and coder, they also demonstrate the leadership qualities needed to rally a team or department to ship outstanding products. A Senior+ Engineer partners with other Engineering leaders (Managers, Directors, VPs) to take joint responsibility for outcomes at team, department and company level. We hire based on academic results and proven execution, and we select those with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will make a significant contribution in Canonical's portfolio through high-quality code, technical leadership, team motivation and direction, exceptional design, and crisp documentation.

As a Senior+ Engineer you'll drive the architecture, design and evolution of high-impact open source software. Our teams work at every level of the stack. From the kernel and system software at the core of Ubuntu through to major language runtimes and the bleeding-edge of cloud automation and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex but highly rewarding projects. Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: we have remote opportunities for Senior Engineers in every time zone.

The role entails

  • Leading design and architecture of an impactful open source project
  • Coding in Golang, Rust, Python, C/C++ or Typescript / React
  • Collaborating proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring, developing and advising colleagues in their career progression
  • Displaying technical leadership in Canonical and our communities
  • Debugging issues and producing high-quality code to fix them
  • Contributing to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
  • Working from home with global travel twice annually for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Technical leadership as well as team motivation, direction and pace
  • Deep experience with at least one of Go, Rust, Python or C
  • Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
  • Excellent communication skills including professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

Depending on your eventual team, you might also bring experience with

  • Container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Highly concurrent, distributed systems
  • Performance engineering – from kernel to web – benchmarks, optimization
  • Software security – fuzzing, tabletop threat models, analysis, audit
  • Build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Public clouds or OpenStack
  • Debian/Ubuntu packaging
  • Systems programming or scalable web services
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front-end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience
  • SQL and NoSQL data store expertise

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Oversee the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC
YOUR PROFILE
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.
Documentation & Ticket Writing

  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.
Who You Are
  • You're fluent in english.

  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.

  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.

Sobre o Pensi

Presentes no Rio de Janeiro, somos a escola responsável pela missão de formar pessoas que busquem sempre evoluir e que sejam capazes de construir um futuro melhor para si e para os que estão ao seu redor. Unindo excelência à formação socioemocional e cidadã dos alunos, o Pensi está sempre atento às demandas das famílias e do mundo. Em 1998, o Pensi foi fundado por engenheiros do IME e do ITA. Rapidamente, tornou-se conhecido pela sua quantidade de aprovações. Entendendo que isso é a concretização de um trabalho acadêmico que começa nos primeiros anos de vida, a instituição ampliou a atuação para o Ensino Básico, inaugurando a Educação Infantil e o Ensino Fundamental I e II.

Para alcançarmos o nosso objetivo, contamos com um time apaixonado pelo poder transformador da educação e que entende o que é ser escola hoje, se preocupando, em primeiro lugar, com os alunos. Aqui você vai encontrar:

Oferecemos conteúdo de qualidade e ferramentas modernas de ensino desde o início da fase escolar dos alunos. Transformamos o estudo em um hábito.

Ajudamos os alunos a desenvolverem responsabilidades tanto acadêmicas quanto com relação às suas escolhas. Buscamos auxiliá-los na procura por diferentes meios para alcançarem os resultados que desejam, com olhar crítico e com a construção de novos pensamentos e ideias.

Nossas escolas promovem um ambiente colaborativo que estimula e reforça o espírito de coletividade. Encorajamos a troca e o diálogo em nossa comunidade escolar.

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, seu lugar é no Pensi.

Descrição da vaga

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Requisitos e qualificações

Art. 1º Fica estabelecido que somente poderá ocupar cargo de Diretor ou Gerente de Unidades de Atenção Primária profissionais que preencham, ao menos, 4 (quatro) dos critérios listados neste artigo.

  • 1º Ter no mínimo 4 (quatro) anos de experiência de atuação direta nas Equipes de Saúde da Família.
  • 2º Ter no mínimo 6 (seis) anos de experiência de atuação na área da Saúde em atividade de apoio às Equipes de Saúde da Família ou Atenção Primária.
  • 3º Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência em cargo de gestão no âmbito do SUS.
  • 4º Ter participado, ao menos, de cinco atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas de Saúde da Família, Saúde Pública, Saúde Coletiva ou Gestão em Saúde (congressos, seminários, workshops, capacitações, cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos, antes da nomeação/contratação.
  • 5º Ter formação técnica de nível médio ou superior na área de Saúde.
  • 6º Ter curso de especialização em Saúde da Família, Saúde Pública, Saúde Coletiva ou Gestão em Saúde.
  • 7º Ter Residência ou título de especialista em Saúde da Família.
  • 8º Ter concluído o terceiro ano de Residência (R3) em Gestão de Serviços de Saúde.
  • 9º Ter título de Mestre ou Doutor em Saúde da Família, Gestão em Saúde, Políticas Públicas e Saúde Coletiva.

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities
  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.
Well/Project Specific Duties
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).
Education
  • Degree in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) – Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.
Experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building.

Our Mobile Platform’s mission aligns with Nubank’s commitment to delivering the best experience for our customers by ensuring a high-performing, stable, and seamless app. Within Mobile Platform, App Core focuses on providing user-friendly, scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient app infrastructure components and mobile tools that enable Nubank engineers to quickly and safely test, deploy, monitor, analyze, and improve app flows and features. The Opportunity : This role will involve working across a variety of technologies, including Native , Flutter , and related frameworks. We are looking for a Mobile Engineer with solid experience to join the App Core team – a cross-impact engineering team responsible for building and maintaining the core infrastructure of the mobile application, optimizing our performance, and enabling product teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.

Must Have

  • Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions.

title: GERENTE DE MARKETING
description:
VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

Objetivo do Cargo

Planejar, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de marketing voltadas para o crescimento e fortalecimento da marca, com o objetivo de aumentar a geração de leads para a equipe de vendas, ampliar as oportunidades de negócios com os clientes existentes e promover o engajamento com todos os stakeholders. Esse profissional terá um papel fundamental na ampliação da presença da marca em regiões estratégicas e na criação de uma conexão mais forte entre o consumidor e a empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Estratégias de Marketing:

  • Elaborar e executar planos de marketing integrados que alinhem as metas de crescimento da empresa com as demandas do mercado.
  • Criar e gerenciar campanhas de marketing com foco em geração de leads, vendas e fortalecimento da marca.

Gestão de Campanhas e Materiais Publicitários:

  • Gerir a criação de campanhas, materiais de PDV e publicações em redes sociais com a agência de propaganda parceira.
  • Garantir que todos os materiais estejam alinhados à identidade e aos valores da marca.

Fortalecimento da Marca:

  • Desenvolver iniciativas para aumentar a visibilidade e relevância da marca entre stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Planejar ações específicas para fortalecer a presença da marca em regiões de alta concorrência.
  • Desenvolver materiais e cuidar de toda a identidade visual dos balcões, garantindo uma boa exposição da marca.

Engajamento com Clientes Atuais:

  • Implementar estratégias que promovam a fidelização e o aumento de vendas entre os clientes existentes.
  • Criar campanhas de incentivo e ações promocionais que incentivem a recompra.

Gestão de Eventos:

  • Planejar e coordenar todos os eventos patrocinados pela empresa, garantindo que estes estejam alinhados aos objetivos de marketing e reforcem a imagem da marca.
  • Gerenciar a execução e a logística dos eventos para maximizar o impacto junto ao público-alvo.

Análise de Desempenho e Relatórios:

  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho das campanhas e ações de marketing, utilizando KPIs e métricas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre o impacto das estratégias de marketing e apresentar recomendações para ajustes.
Habilidades Comportamentais
  1. Adaptabilidade e Resiliência
  2. Comunicação Clara
  3. Foco em Resultado
  4. Mão na Massa e atitude de dono
  5. Criatividade na solução
Pré-requisitos
  • Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de gestão na área de marketing, preferencialmente em indústrias de bens de consumo;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de eventos e relacionamento com agências de publicidade;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de campanhas regionais para aumentar a penetração de mercado em áreas concorridas;
  • Habilidades em marketing de relacionamento e fidelização de clientes.

Gerente de Impostos Diretos, Rio de Janeiro

EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Na EY, estamos comprometidos em moldar seu futuro com confiança.

Nós ajudaremos você a ter sucesso em um ambiente globalmente conectado, repleto de equipes diversas, e a levar sua carreira para onde você desejar.

Venha para EY e ajude-nos a construir um mundo de negócios melhor.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Você atuará como Gerente de Impostos diretos na área de TAX.

Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades:
  • Liderar vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações. Orientar a equipe na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos Imposto de Renda de Pessoas Jurídicas (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL);
